one_line: Eleventh-century Kashmiri Sanskrit poet whose journeys through major Indian courts culminated in praising Western Chalukya king Vikramaditya VI.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, lean scholar’s build, slightly travel-worn but dignified.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium wheatish Kashmiri complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, thoughtful eyes with a calm, observant default expression.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, medium length to the nape, neatly combed back and tied into a small low knot; a simple cream-colored cloth headband wraps around the forehead, knotted at the back.
appearance.costume: Layered eleventh-century scholar’s attire: an inner long-sleeved cotton tunic (kurta-like) in soft off-white reaching to mid-thigh; over it a finely woven light saffron-colored uttariya (shawl) draped around both shoulders and falling in front; lower garment is a tightly wrapped dhoti in pale muted green with a narrow darker green border, knotted securely at the front and reaching the ankles; simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery limited to a small copper signet ring on the right hand and a plain dark wooden bead mala wrapped twice around the left wrist, suggesting piety without ostentation; textiles appear handwoven and slightly worn from travel, with very subtle striped texture in the dhoti but no elaborate patterns.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord, tucked under his left arm, with the loose end of the saffron shawl resting over it.

ref_desc: Bilhana is a lean, early-40s Kashmiri poet with an oval wheatish face, tied-back dark hair and cream headband, wearing off-white tunic, saffron shawl, pale green dhoti and brown sandals, carrying a red-tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Bilhana: a lean, early-40s Kashmiri poet with an oval wheatish face, high cheekbones, sharp nose, thoughtful eyes, and a neat moustache with short beard. His dark brown-black hair is combed back into a small low knot, wrapped by a simple cream-colored cloth headband around the forehead. He wears an off-white long-sleeved tunic reaching mid-thigh, over which a light saffron-colored shawl is draped around both shoulders and hanging in front. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped pale muted green dhoti with a narrow darker green border reaching the ankles, and he stands in plain brown leather sandals. A plain dark wooden bead mala is wrapped twice around his left wrist, and a small copper signet ring sits on his right hand. Under his left arm he carries a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied firmly with a red cord, with the end of the saffron shawl resting over it. Show him in a neutral, dignified stance with calm expression, clearly presenting face, hair, garments head-to-toe, and the manuscript, with colors dominated by off-white, light saffron, pale green, brown, and red.
